Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary — that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from AP/Procurement: 

- PO threshold: Finance requires a vendor record + PO for any vendor where expected annual spend exceeds $50,000. For a short POC under $5k we usually allow payment by company card charged to the BU card.
- Vendor onboarding: we require a completed vendor intake form, W-9 (if US entity), and a brief security attestation for SaaS vendors. Typical onboarding time once paperwork submitted is ~2–4 weeks.
- Marketplace: we prefer marketplace purchases for smaller tools because billing and procurement overhead are minimal, but for platform deals we usually do direct PO.

Action items from my side: I can start vendor intake once you send W-9 and a one-page security summary. Procurement will own the PO creation — I'm copying them so they have visibility.

For the POC, if you can accept card for up to $5k, we can spin up the trial ASAP and parallelize the vendor onboarding.
